p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

if k != 1 and k != 0:
    visited = [True] * p
    total_value = 1
    for start_point in range(1, p):
        if visited[start_point]:
            val = start_point
            while True:
                val = (val * k) % p
                visited[val] = False
                if val == start_point:
                    break
            total_value = (total_value * p) % MOD
    print(total_value)
elif k == 1:
    prod = 1
    for _ in range(p):
        prod = (prod * p) % MOD
    print(prod)
else:
    prod = 1
    for _ in range(p - 1):
        prod = (prod * p) % MOD
    print(prod)
